tips.intro: 2048 Cube Run is a runner where a numbered cube rolls down a long white track on its own and picks up more numbered cubes along the way. These tips come from runs on Level 1, including one that reached the finish strips and one that ended back at the start screen.
tips: Press CLICK TO START! under the floating cube on the Level 1 screen. The run begins at once and the cube keeps moving forward without any input.
Hold the mouse button and drag sideways to move your cube across the track. Dragging left slid it toward the left side, so small drags are enough to line up with a cube ahead.
Stay away from the very edge of the track. In one run the cube was dragged all the way to the left edge, and a few seconds later the game was back on the Level 1 start screen.
Cubes you collect stack up on your cube in a column. In one run the stack grew to show 2, 2, 8, 4, 128 and 32 before the finish line, so it is worth chasing the cubes in your lane.
Past the checkered finish line the track turns into colored strips marked X2, X4 and higher. Your stack is spent along those strips, so a taller stack carries you further.
tips.conclusion: Start the run, keep your cube near the middle with short drags and grab what sits in your lane. A tall stack at the finish line is what pushes you up the multiplier strips.

extra_sections.heading: What happens at the finish line
paragraphs: After the checkered line, the track becomes a ramp of colored strips. The first was a wide dark blue X2 strip, then a green X4 strip, with more strips with higher values beyond it. As the cube climbs them, the stack shrinks until only a single cube is left.

Then the Level Cleared screen appears. On Level 1 it showed REWARD +100 coins and a curved bar of multipliers reading x2, x3, x4, x3 and x2 with a moving arrow above a WATCH ADS & GET button, which offers extra coins (+200 and +300 were shown). NEXT LEVEL sits on the same screen as WATCH ADS & GET (we didn't press it).

extra_sections.heading: Coins and the Cube Value card
paragraphs: Coins in 2048 Cube Run are in-game points only. They are earned by playing and no real money is involved. The coin total sits in the top right corner, and it read 500 at the start of Level 1.

Below the starting cube is a Cube Value card that showed a 2 cube, x2 and the number 1000 next to a coin icon. That was more than the 500 coins on hand, so the card was not used in testing and its effect was not seen.

controls.intro: 2048 Cube Run needs very little input. You start the run with one click, the cube moves forward by itself, and you steer by dragging.
controls.desktop: Click CLICK TO START! to begin. Then hold the left mouse button and drag left or right to move the cube across the track. Release when it is where you want it. Arrow keys were also pressed during testing, but the drag was the input that clearly moved the cube.
tips: Click Ok, Play Now! on the first notice and wait for the game to load before you try to start.
Use short drags. A long drag to the edge of the track was followed by the run ending.
A gear icon sits in the top left corner of the Level 1 start screen.
NEXT LEVEL sits on the same screen as WATCH ADS & GET (we didn't press it).

beginner-guide.intro: New to 2048 Cube Run? Here is what each screen shows and how a first run on Level 1 goes from the start button to the Level Cleared screen.
beginner-guide.what_it_is: 2048 Cube Run is a free browser runner with a numbers theme. You control a blue cube marked 2 on a long white track over a light blue sky. Colored cubes with numbers such as 2, 4, 8, 16, 64 and 128 sit on the track, and the ones you run into stack up on your cube. At the end, a checkered finish line leads onto strips marked X2, X4 and more, and the level ends on a Level Cleared screen.
first_steps: Click Ok, Play Now! on the notice and let the game load to the Level 1 screen.
Look at the coin total in the top right and the Cube Value card below the starting cube.
Click CLICK TO START! to set the cube moving.
Hold the mouse button and make small drags left and right to line up with cubes ahead.
Keep an eye on the progress bar at the top as you near the finish line.
Look over the Level Cleared screen. NEXT LEVEL sits on the same screen as WATCH ADS & GET (we didn't press it).
beginner-guide.who_its_for: Players who want a short, low-effort runner with one simple input. Each run on Level 1 lasted well under a minute.

extra_sections.heading: Reading the screen during a run
paragraphs: The bar at the top of the screen fills from left to right as you move down the track, with a small marker at each end. The coin count stays in the top right corner.
Your stack shows its numbers on the front of each cube, so you can see at a glance which values you have picked up. Cubes waiting on the track show their numbers too.

similar.intro: 2048 Cube Run is about steering one stack down a straight track and grabbing as much as you can before the finish line. The forward movement is automatic, so the only choice is where to be on the road. If you like that kind of quick run, where a few small sideways moves decide the score and a level lasts less than a minute, the games below are worth a try. Look for games with simple one-hand controls, numbers or stacks that grow as you play, and a clear finish line.

faqs.question: How do you start a run in 2048 Cube Run?
faqs.answer: Click CLICK TO START! below the floating cube on the level screen. The cube starts rolling down the track straight away.

faqs.question: How do you steer the cube?
faqs.answer: Hold the left mouse button and drag left or right. The cube moves across the track while you drag and keeps moving forward on its own.

faqs.question: What happens to the cubes you collect?
faqs.answer: They stack on top of your cube in a column, each showing its number. In one Level 1 run the stack showed 2, 2, 8, 4, 128 and 32 by the finish line.

faqs.question: What are the X2 and X4 strips after the finish line?
faqs.answer: They are colored strips past the checkered finish line. Your stack is used up as the cube climbs them, and a taller stack reaches further strips.

faqs.question: What does the Level Cleared screen give you?
faqs.answer: On Level 1 it showed REWARD +100 coins, a bar of multipliers from x2 to x4, a WATCH ADS & GET button and a NEXT LEVEL button. Coins are in-game points only, with no real money involved.

faqs.question: Do you have to watch an ad to keep playing?
faqs.answer: WATCH ADS & GET is optional and offers extra coins (+200 and +300 were shown). NEXT LEVEL sits on the same screen as WATCH ADS & GET (we didn't press it).

faqs.question: What is the Cube Value card?
faqs.answer: It sits under the starting cube and showed a 2 cube, x2 and the number 1000 next to a coin icon. The game started with only 500 coins, so the card was not used and its effect was not seen.

faqs.question: Are the coins real money?
faqs.answer: No. Coins are in-game points earned by playing 2048 Cube Run. No real money was involved anywhere in the game during testing.
